Fast Solvers for Things
Jane Doe, Example University

Abstract
We propose GridNet, a multigrid solver for elliptic equations. GridNet reduces error by 40% on the Poisson benchmark.

1. Introduction
Learned solvers are slow on fine grids. We show that equivariance improves accuracy of learned solvers.

2. Method
GridNet uses multigrid coarsening with a conservation law penalty on every level.
The update is u = A u + b (1)

3. Experiments
3.1. Setup
We evaluate on the Poisson benchmark and on the Darcy benchmark with 1,000 test fields.
3.2. Results
GridNet reaches an error of 0.012 on the Darcy benchmark, against 0.030 for the baseline.
Table 1. Error on Darcy and Poisson.
GridNet 0.012 0.020 Baseline 0.030 0.041

4. Conclusion
GridNet does not improve on turbulent flows, which remain open.
